title: Interaction priority zones and resizable split-views for Console dashboards
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Introduce a predictable interaction model for high-density console dashboards by defining 'interaction priority zones' and adding optional resizable split-views. Scope covers tables, charts, and modal overlays on dashboard pages and the Rollouts/Cost views. Goal is to reduce accidental activations on touch/trackpad, keep important controls visible in narrow widths, and provide a stable resizing affordance for power users. Work includes prototypes, cross-browser testing, accessibility review, and handoff artifacts for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Priority zones defined and documented with visual affordances for desktop and touch
Resizable split-view implemented as a design pattern spec with behavior for min/max constraints
Chart and table headers remain accessible and do not overlap modals at common breakpoints (>=320px)
Interaction tests for mouse, keyboard, and touch pass in Chrome, Safari, Firefox (latest stable) and Edge
Design tokens and CSS variable recommendations provided for engineers, with examples for Fluid/Fixed sizing
Figma prototype linked and validated by PM + Eng during handoff
design_decisions: Use three priority zones across the horizontal axis (Primary / Secondary / Tertiary) to guide click/touch targets; primary zone contains main action buttons and persisting small controls
Expose a 1px draggable gutter with a 12px hit target using pseudo-elements so visual layout doesn't change when hover hits; this balances visual density and usability
Avoid persistent split-view when window width < 720px; instead default to stacked flows with quick toggle to temporary split to preserve mobile clarity
Prefer CSS grid with named areas for layout so engineers can implement responsive reflows without JS for common cases; use JS only for animated resizes and persisted layout state
Tradeoff: draggable split gives power users control but adds complexity to autoscaling/analytics; we'll emit events for resize actions and limit to Dedicated/Hosted tiers in initial rollout
reviews: 2025-09-12: PM review (Sofia Park) - requested explicit behavior for autosave of split state across sessions; assigned to ENG-20431
2025-09-13: Accessibility review (Theo Ramirez) - keyboard focus order must follow priority zones; added aria-describedby guidance
2025-09-15: Engineering review (Priya Singh) - suggested using pointer-events passthrough for overlay gutters to avoid hit-test conflicts; accepted
2025-09-17: Design critique (Design Team) - visual affordance for gutter needs a subtle hover reveal; updated prototype
tasks: Finalize visual token mapping and provide CSS variables (design -> eng)
Add unit test checklist for interaction telemetry events (ENG)

notes: Test matrix includes latest stable Chrome, Safari (macOS & iOS), Firefox, Edge on Win/macOS and iPadOS (touch) - special attention to Safari pointer and scroll chaining bugs
Observed flicker in older Safari when transitioning grid-template-rows during resize; mitigation: defer transition on layout-only changes and animate overlay highlights instead
Ensure telemetry emits 'split_resize' events with previous_width, new_width, and user_origin to support cost/runtime heuristics in Optimize
